madhura avastha paka.title: Madhura avastha pāka
madhura avastha paka.body: The sweet stage of digestion, beginning in the mouth.

bodhaka kapha.title: Bodhaka kapha
bodhaka kapha.body: The subtype of kapha in the mouth that moistens food and enables taste.

the bhutas.title: The bhūtas
the bhutas.body: The five great elements: earth, water, fire, air, and ether.

saliva.title: Saliva
saliva.body: Watery fluid in the mouth that begins digestion.

salivary glands.title: Salivary glands
salivary glands.body: Glands that secrete saliva into the mouth.

parotid.title: Parotid
parotid.body: The largest pair of salivary glands, in front of the ears.

chemical digestion.title: Chemical digestion
chemical digestion.body: Breaking food down with enzymes and acids.

bolus.title: Bolus
bolus.body: The ball of chewed food ready to be swallowed.

tongue.title: Tongue
tongue.body: The muscular organ of taste and speech.

hypothalamus.title: Hypothalamus
hypothalamus.body: A brain region governing many automatic body functions.

sadhaka pitta.title: Sādhaka pitta
sadhaka pitta.body: The subtype of pitta in the heart and brain governing perception and cognition.

prana vayu.title: Prāna vāyu
prana vayu.body: The subtype of vata governing intake — breath and swallowing.

pharynx.title: Pharynx
pharynx.body: The throat — the passage behind the mouth leading to the esophagus.

esophagus.title: Esophagus
esophagus.body: The muscular tube carrying food from throat to stomach.

peristalsis.title: Peristalsis
peristalsis.body: Wave-like muscle contractions that move food along.

fundus.title: Fundus
fundus.body: The upper, dome-shaped part of the stomach.

samana vayu.title: Samāna vāyu
samana vayu.body: The subtype of vata that churns and moves food through digestion.

rasa dhatu.title: Rasa dhātu
rasa dhatu.body: Plasma — the first and most basic body tissue.

thyroid.title: Thyroid
thyroid.body: The gland in the neck that regulates metabolism.

lungs.title: Lungs
lungs.body: The organs of breathing and gas exchange.

vipaka.title: Vipāka
vipaka.body: The post-digestive effect — the lasting taste a food leaves after digestion.

anabolic.title: Anabolic
anabolic.body: Building up — processes that construct body tissue.

kapha dosha.title: Kapha dosha
kapha dosha.body: The dosha of structure and cohesion (earth and water).

bhutas.title: Bhūtas
bhutas.body: The five great elements: earth, water, fire, air, and ether.

agni.title: Āgni
agni.body: The metabolic fire that transforms food into nourishment.

jathara agni.title: Jāthara agni
jathara agni.body: The central digestive fire of the stomach and small intestine.

pachaka pitta.title: Pāchaka pitta
pachaka pitta.body: The subtype of pitta in the stomach that drives digestion.

hydrochloric acid hcl.title: Hydrochloric acid (HCl)
hydrochloric acid hcl.body: Strong stomach acid that breaks down food and kills germs.

pepsin.title: Pepsin
pepsin.body: A stomach enzyme that breaks down protein.

kledaka kapha.title: Kledaka kapha
kledaka kapha.body: The subtype of kapha in the stomach that moistens and protects its lining.

mucous membrane.title: Mucous membrane
mucous membrane.body: The protective lining of the digestive tract.

shleshma dhara kala.title: Shleshma dhārā kalā
shleshma dhara kala.body: The mucous-membrane layer protecting the stomach lining.

chyme.title: Chyme
chyme.body: The semi-liquid mass of partly digested food.

pyloric valve.title: Pyloric valve
pyloric valve.body: The opening from the stomach into the small intestine.

pyloric sphincter.title: Pyloric sphincter
pyloric sphincter.body: The ring of muscle controlling the pyloric valve.

duodenum.title: Duodenum
duodenum.body: The first section of the small intestine.

virya.title: Vīrya
virya.body: The potency of a substance — its warming or cooling energy.

lavana avastha paka.title: Lavana avastha pāka
lavana avastha paka.body: The salty stage of digestion, in the first part of the small intestine.

stomach.title: Stomach
stomach.body: The organ where food is churned and broken down by acid.

the small intestine secretes.title: The small intestine secretes
the small intestine secretes.body: The small intestine releases its own digestive enzymes.

small intestine.title: Small intestine
small intestine.body: Where most digestion and absorption of nutrients occurs.

liver.title: Liver
liver.body: The organ that produces bile and processes nutrients.

pancreas.title: Pancreas
pancreas.body: The gland that secretes digestive enzymes and hormones.

duct.title: Duct
duct.body: A tube carrying secretions, such as bile or enzymes.

secretin.title: Secretin
secretin.body: A hormone that triggers release of bicarbonate to neutralize acid.

kloma agni.title: Kloma agni
kloma agni.body: The digestive fire associated with the pancreas.

hydrochloric acid.title: Hydrochloric acid
hydrochloric acid.body: Strong stomach acid that breaks down food and kills germs.

cholecystokinin.title: Cholecystokinin
cholecystokinin.body: A hormone that releases bile and pancreatic enzymes.

cck.title: CCK
cck.body: Cholecystokinin — a hormone releasing bile and enzymes.

pancreatic digestive enzymes.title: Pancreatic digestive enzymes
pancreatic digestive enzymes.body: Enzymes from the pancreas that break down food.

bile.title: Bile
bile.body: Liver fluid that emulsifies fats for digestion.

ranjaka pitta.title: Rañjaka pitta
ranjaka pitta.body: The subtype of pitta in the liver that colors blood and bile.

gallbladder.title: Gallbladder
gallbladder.body: The organ that stores and releases bile.

kidneys.title: Kidneys
kidneys.body: Organs that filter the blood and form urine.

katu avastha paka.title: Katu avastha pāka
katu avastha paka.body: The pungent stage of digestion, in the jejunum.

jejunum.title: Jejunum
jejunum.body: The second section of the small intestine.

vayu.title: Vāyu
vayu.body: Wind or air; the vital movement-force, also called vata.

thermogenesis.title: Thermogenesis
thermogenesis.body: The production of heat by the body.

gi tract.title: GI tract
gi tract.body: The gastrointestinal tract — the whole digestive passage.

ileum.title: Ileum
ileum.body: The third and longest section of the small intestine.

colon.title: Colon
colon.body: The main part of the large intestine.

chyle.title: Chyle
chyle.body: Milky fluid of absorbed fats carried by the lymph.

heart.title: Heart
heart.body: The organ that pumps blood through the body.

diaphragm.title: Diaphragm
diaphragm.body: The muscle beneath the lungs that drives breathing.

tikta avastha paka.title: Tikta avastha pāka
tikta avastha paka.body: The bitter stage of digestion, in the ileum.

akasha.title: Ākāsha
akasha.body: Ether or space — one of the five elements.

villi.title: Villi
villi.body: Tiny finger-like projections in the intestine that absorb nutrients.

spleen.title: Spleen
spleen.body: An organ involved in blood filtering and immunity.

kashaya avastha paka.title: Kashāya avastha pāka
kashaya avastha paka.body: The astringent stage of digestion, in the large intestine.

large intestine.title: Large intestine
large intestine.body: Where water is absorbed and waste is formed; the colon.

apana vayu.title: Apāna vāyu
apana vayu.body: The downward-moving subtype of vata governing elimination.

ileocecal valve.title: Ileocecal valve
ileocecal valve.body: The valve between the small and large intestine.

cecum.title: Cecum
cecum.body: The pouch at the start of the large intestine.

ascending colon.title: Ascending colon
ascending colon.body: The first, upward-running part of the colon.

hepatic flexure.title: Hepatic flexure
hepatic flexure.body: The bend in the colon near the liver.

splenic flexure.title: Splenic flexure
splenic flexure.body: The bend in the colon near the spleen.

sigmoid colon.title: Sigmoid colon
sigmoid colon.body: The S-shaped final section of the colon before the rectum.

poshaka vata.title: Poshaka vata
poshaka vata.body: The nourishing aspect of vata supporting bodily functions.

rectum.title: Rectum
rectum.body: The final straight section of the large intestine.

anal canal.title: Anal canal
anal canal.body: The short passage at the end of the rectum.

anus.title: Anus
anus.body: The opening through which waste leaves the body.

ruksha.title: Ruksha
ruksha.body: Dry — a Vāta quality (dry skin, hair, and organs).

laghu.title: Laghu
laghu.body: Light — a quality giving a thin frame and scanty sleep.

khara.title: Khara
khara.body: Rough — a Vāta quality (cracked skin, cracking joints).

sukshma.title: Sukshma
sukshma.body: Subtle — a Vāta quality (fine tremors and subtle fears).

vishada.title: Vishada
vishada.body: Clear — a Vāta quality (clarity, but also a sense of emptiness).

akruti.title: Ākruti
akruti.body: The physical form or constitution of a person.

sarpa.title: Sarpa
sarpa.body: Serpent — the Vāta pulse, fast and thin like a moving snake.

tikshna.title: Tikshna
tikshna.body: Sharp — a Pitta quality (sharp intellect, penetrating eyes).

drava.title: Drava
drava.body: Liquid — a Pitta quality (sweat, frequent urination, loose stools).

snigdha.title: Snigdha
snigdha.body: Oily — a quality giving soft, oily skin and hair.

saram.title: Saram
saram.body: Spreading — a Pitta quality (rashes or inflammation that spread).

visra.title: Visra
visra.body: Fleshy or fetid smell — a Pitta body-odor quality.

tikshna agni.title: Tikshna Agni
tikshna agni.body: Sharp digestive fire — Pitta’s strong, intense appetite.

manduka.title: Manduka
manduka.body: Frog — the Pitta pulse, jumping, bounding, and forceful.

guru.title: Guru
guru.body: Heavy — a Kapha quality (heavy bones and muscles).

manda.title: Manda
manda.body: Slow or dull — a Kapha quality (slow movement and metabolism).

shlakshna.title: Shlakshna
shlakshna.body: Smooth — a Kapha quality (smoothness of skin and organs).

sandra.title: Sandra
sandra.body: Dense — a Kapha quality (thickset body, compact tissues).

mrudu.title: Mrudu
mrudu.body: Soft — a Kapha quality (soft skin, gentle nature).

sthira.title: Sthira
sthira.body: Stable or static — a Kapha quality (steadiness, sedentary tendency).

picchila.title: Picchila
picchila.body: Cloudy or sticky — a Kapha quality (cohesion; mental fog when imbalanced).

avila.title: Avila
avila.body: Cloudy — a Kapha quality paired with picchila.

sthula.title: Sthula
sthula.body: Gross or large — a Kapha quality (visible bulk).

manda agni.title: Manda Agni
manda agni.body: Slow digestive fire — Kapha’s steady but sluggish appetite.

hamsa.title: Hamsa
hamsa.body: Swan — the Kapha pulse, slow, deep, and wavy.

gunas.title: Gunas
gunas.body: The qualities or attributes that define each dosha.

amla avastha paka.title: Amla avastha pāka
amla avastha paka.body: The sour stage of digestion, occurring in the stomach.

enzymes.title: Enzymes
enzymes.body: Proteins that speed up the body’s chemical reactions, such as breaking down food.
